facts.fact: The terms of reference state the Epicor-based IFMIS is currently used by all Lesotho ministries and councils and by foreign missions in South Africa and Ethiopia (document undated; published date 2026-08-26 used).

systems.system: Integrated Financial Management Information System (Epicor 10.2, upgrade to Epicor Kinetic planned)
systems.owner: Ministry of Finance and Development Planning
systems.tiers: all ministries and councils, foreign missions

systems.system: Digital Signature Service, EPM Payment Gateway, X-Road data exchange platform
